append.detail: 2026-11-09: added scripts/audit/route-family-audit.mjs, a runnable route-family audit. It visits 25 public route families at 390 and 1280 and records HTTP status, page and console errors, horizontal overflow, axe WCAG A/AA serious and critical violations and a full-page screenshot, writing report.json, report.md and shots/. Checked against a static page where it caught overflow and a missing image alt. It could not run against the app from the cloud sandbox: next dev needs NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and the sandbox has no credentials. Run it with BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000 (a local pnpm dev) or a preview URL, then file each finding as its own row. Signed-in, admin, API, security-boundary, SEO and performance proof are not covered by this script. Row stays OPEN.
